bundlingNotes: This is a pure title-premium rate manual; Wyoming's residential closings are handled by title companies (not attorneys), and this manual confirms the WY market convention -- matching most other 'scarce' states surveyed -- of pricing title premium and settlement/escrow/closing services as two entirely separate, unfiled/unpublished matters. A 2025-08-25 rate-filing update was confirmed to exist via Virtual Underwriter bulletin WY2025002 (Wyoming DOI approved a new Stewart rate submission), and its effective date exactly matches independent agent Black Hills Title's own WY rate-sheet vintage below -- but the actual updated Stewart PDF could not be located at a working public URL this session, so the 2016 vintage remains the only verifiable Stewart WY document.
transactionContext: Owner's (Standard, Extended, Homeowner's) and Loan (Standard, Extended) policy premium schedules, statewide, no metro/county tiering. No settlement/escrow/closing-service fee breakdown.

bundlingNotes: WTE separately publishes a Home Seller's Handbook and Homebuyer's Handbook (both fetched this session) that name 'Escrow Fees' and 'Title Insurance Premium' as distinct, separately-charged line items on a Wyoming closing statement -- confirming the same premium/settlement-fee split documented industry-wide -- but neither handbook contains a single dollar figure for any fee; both are purely descriptive glossaries and process-flow diagrams. WTE's own site states actual rate quotes require its login-gated 'WTE Companion' portal (companion.wyomingtitle.com), not published publicly. This Partial Rate Schedule PDF is the only static, dollar-denominated WTE/First American document located this session, and it is premium-only.

endpointOrParams: Genuine JSON REST API at /api/SRC/*, driven via plain HTTP GET/POST (no browser/JS execution) -- the recipe fully documented in CALCULATORS.md's 2026-08-14 entry, applied unmodified. Sequence: GET /api/SRC/transactiontypes?statecode=WY -> GET /api/SRC/propertysearch?value=Cheyenne,%20WY (resolves Laramie County) -> GET /api/SRC/statesettings?statecode=WY -> GET /api/SRC/providers?statecode=WY&countycode=<FIPS>&zipcode=<ZIP>&transactiontype=SALE -> GET /api/SRC/ernstlookup -> two POST /api/SRC/quote calls (QuoteType=3 for itemized settlement fees, QuoteType=2 for recording/transfer-tax), each form-urlencoded with a hand-built QuoteRequestRoot JSON. No personal-data fields required or entered.
scenario: $500,000 purchase price / $400,000 loan amount, Laramie County (Cheyenne), residential resale, Sale/Purchase with Mortgage transaction.
methodology: Same nationwide-reusable Stewart /api/SRC/quote recipe already applied to WV/NH/ME/RI/DE/SD (see CALCULATORS.md's 2026-08-14 entry for the full technical writeup); zero recipe modification needed.
